left.heading: DSC
left.alt: Wiring diagram: DSC panel keypad bus to T16. RED (+12V) to + DC, BLK to - DC, YEL to Rx/CLK, GRN to Tx/DATA.

right.heading: PARADOX
right.alt: Wiring diagram: PARADOX panel to T16 through the EX-CRP2.4 cable, ordered separately. +AUX (+12V) and red wire R to + DC; -AUX and black wire B to - DC; yellow wire Y to Rx/CLK; green wire G to Tx/DATA.

left.heading: CADDX
left.alt: Wiring diagram: CADDX panel keypad bus to T16. POS (+12V) to + DC, COM to - DC, DATA to Tx/DATA; Rx/CLK is unused.

right.heading: TEXECOM
right.alt: Wiring diagram: TEXECOM panel to T16 through the EX-CRP4 cable, ordered separately. +DC (+12V) and red wire R to + DC; -DC and black wire B to - DC; blue wire BL to Rx/CLK; white wire W to Tx/DATA.

left.heading: CROW Runner
left.alt: Wiring diagram: CROW Runner panel keypad bus to T16. POS (+12V) to + DC, NEG to - DC, CLK to Rx/CLK, DATA to Tx/DATA.

right.heading: SECOLink
right.alt: Wiring diagram: SECOLink panel to T16 through the EX-CRP4 cable, ordered separately. +AUX (+12V) and red wire R to + DC; COM and black wire B to - DC; blue wire BL to Rx/CLK; white wire W to Tx/DATA.

left.heading: ARGUS-SPEKTR STRELEC
left.alt: Wiring diagram: ARGUS-SPEKTR STRELEC panel to T16. +PWR (+12V) to + DC, GND to - DC, TD to Rx/CLK, RD to Tx/DATA.

right.heading: BOLID C2000
right.alt: Wiring diagram: BOLID C2000 panel to T16. +U (+12V) to + DC, GND to - DC, Tx to Rx/CLK, Rx to Tx/DATA.

left.heading: PYRONIX
left.alt: Wiring diagram: PYRONIX Matrix panel to T16. +AUX (+12V) to + DC, -AUX to - DC, KD to Tx/DATA; Rx/CLK is unused.

right.heading: ROVALANT A6-06
right.alt: Wiring diagram: ROVALANT A6-06 panel to T16. SLOT XP4 connects to the ИС-RF serial module; Rovalant +12V to T16 + DC and -12V to - DC. The ИС-RF serial connector has three leads, to T16 - DC (joined with the -12V line at a dot), Rx/CLK and Tx/DATA; no connector lead goes to + DC.

left.heading: RISCO LightSYS
left.alt: Wiring diagram: RISCO LightSYS panel keypad bus to T16. RED (+12V) to + DC, BLK to - DC, YEL to Rx/CLK, GRN to Tx/DATA.

right.heading: HONEYWELL VISTA
right.alt: Wiring diagram: HONEYWELL VISTA panel keypad bus to T16. Terminal 4 to - DC, 5 to + DC, 6 to Tx/DATA, 7 to Rx/CLK; each pair of wires crosses without a junction dot.

left.heading: Without landline control
left.alt: Wiring diagram: control panel landline dialer to T16. +AUX (+12 V) to + DC, -AUX to - DC, RING to COM/RING, TIP to TIP.

right.heading: With landline control
right.alt: Wiring diagram: control panel landline dialer to T16 with landline control. +AUX (+12 V) to + DC, -AUX to - DC, RING to COM/RING, TIP to TIP, plus panel R-1 to T16 IN1/R-1 and T-1 to IN2/T-1.

parts.heading: Normally open (NO)
parts.alt: Input circuit: normally open (NO) contact between COM and INx. Shorted - alarm; open - restore.

parts.heading: Normally closed (NC)
parts.alt: Input circuit: normally closed (NC) contact between COM and INx. Shorted - restore; open - alarm.

parts.heading: Normally closed with 2.2k end-of-line resistor (EOL)
parts.alt: Input circuit: NC contact with a 2.2k end of line resistor (EOL) in series between COM and INx. Shorted - alarm; open - alarm; 2.2k - restore.

parts.heading: Normally open with 2.2k end-of-line resistor (EOL)
parts.alt: Input circuit: NO contact with a 2.2k end of line resistor (EOL) in parallel between COM and INx. Shorted - alarm; open - alarm; 2.2k - restore.

left.heading: Wi-Fi module W485
left.alt: Wiring diagram: panel to T16 and the Wi-Fi module W485. +AUX (+12 V) to both +DC terminals; -AUX to both -DC terminals; T16 A 485 to W485 A 485 and B 485 to B 485. RS485 connection up to 100 m.

right.heading: TM17 reader
right.alt: Wiring diagram: T16 to the TM17 reader. A 12 V, 1,5 A DC source powers both devices; TM17 red wire to +DC, blue to -DC, black to T16 A 485, white to T16 B 485.
